title: Authorize comment-triggered Claude review
reproduction: A comment on a PR containing @claude from any association satisfies either comment branch; when CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is configured it can invoke the credentialed action
root_cause: Comment text is treated as authorization
test_plan: Offline failing workflow-contract test: require comment-author association on both comment branches; allow exactly OWNER MEMBER COLLABORATOR; deny NONE and unlisted values; preserve automatic pull_request review
rollback_plan: Disable both comment triggers and their branches while retaining automatic pull_request review
decision_reason: Recomputed 90 = 94 positive - 4 complexity; two independent auditors confirmed a narrow reversible caller-authorization defect outside protected WIP

title: Validate actual Git remote ownership before global auto-push
reproduction: A non-GitHub URL containing /<cached-login>/ passes each case pattern and reaches git push
root_cause: Unparsed URL substring stands in for remote identity
test_plan: Fake remotes covering HTTPS SSH pushurl and spoofed hosts; assert no push
rollback_plan: Restore prior hooks and reinstall only after owner review
hard_gate: protected WIP plus operational push-authority change
decision_reason: High raw value but the shared root control overlaps protected WIP and changes network push authority

title: Validate Host or local capability on live dashboard
reproduction: Arbitrary Host reaches /live.json; remote disclosure additionally needs DNS rebinding or an equivalent browser bypass
root_cause: Loopback binding is treated as the complete origin boundary
test_plan: HTTP tests for accepted loopback Host rejected arbitrary Host and zero refresh calls
rollback_plan: Remove Host gate and retain loopback binding
decision_reason: Exploitability and user impact are conditional and unmeasured; first reproduce the deployed browser boundary

title: Bind existing Schwab packages into irreplaceable-data inventory
reproduction: Inventory records Schwab namespaces absent so verify skips their now-present bytes
root_cause: Inventory was not refreshed after the Schwab namespaces became populated
test_plan: Absent-then-populated-then-removed namespace fixture must fail; deep canonical verification
rollback_plan: Restore reviewed inventory and preserve all bytes
decision_reason: Critical retention blind spot but regenerating the authoritative data inventory is an operational data-authority mutation

title: Enforce constituent quote freshness for selectable Schwab rows
reproduction: Four packages contain 3294 rows older than 15 minutes including one prior-session quote; none is currently selectable
root_cause: Package verification checks receipt freshness but not per-contract timestamp age
test_plan: Synthetic selectable same-session-old and prior-session rows with fail-closed result
rollback_plan: Disable the new gate and restore prior receipt behavior
hard_gate: provider/data-authority change plus protected WIP and missing owner threshold
decision_reason: A threshold cannot be invented in the audit and the exact gate is protected/authority-bearing

title: Hash-bind close acquisition provenance
reproduction: Current close writes retain transformed bytes but no raw response hash or per-symbol acquisition binding
root_cause: Close refresh records aggregate facts rather than durable raw-to-derived lineage
test_plan: Synthetic raw response to transformed hash lineage and mutation refusal
rollback_plan: Remove additive receipt producer without rewriting prior data
decision_reason: Useful design but it changes acquisition authority and requires a separately authorized provider workflow

title: Add local process-capacity preflight before full suite
reproduction: Host had 797 external zombies and exceeded its 1333 process ceiling; isolated failing tests passed
root_cause: Test runner does not classify process exhaustion before subprocess-heavy integration tests
test_plan: Synthetic process-stat parser and explicit EAGAIN diagnostic
decision_reason: External host repair is the real blocker and another local wrapper would add maintenance without fixing the zombie owner

title: Add macOS zsh contract CI coverage
reproduction: Ubuntu-only CI skips macOS/zsh wrapper contracts
root_cause: The only required CI platform is Ubuntu
test_plan: Run existing mock-only zsh tests with provider/network denial and publish skip counts
decision_reason: Good coverage value but runner cost availability and owner CI policy need a dedicated plan

title: Add isolated repo-rag tests to CI
reproduction: Root CI never invokes the tracked 11-file repo-rag suite
root_cause: Independent tracked tool is outside the principal CI contract
test_plan: Offline stdlib-only python3 -m unittest discover -s tests job from tools/repo_rag
decision_reason: Narrow and reversible but lower risk reduction than SEC-01 and needs support-status ownership

title: Add Ruff format check to CI
reproduction: ruff format --check currently reports 281 files would reformat
root_cause: CI omits a declared check while repository-wide format debt already exists
test_plan: Run format check only after a separately approved baseline cleanup
hard_gate: would make current CI fail and broad formatting is prohibited
decision_reason: Adding the gate now would create a known red build and the required mass-format sweep is forbidden

title: Model daily ritual as a typed shadow workflow plan
reproduction: One 619-line shell path owns authority data refresh receipts Git persistence and backup
root_cause: Stateful orchestration and authority sequencing are concentrated in shell
test_plan: Side-effect-free parity model over existing shell order and declared writes
rollback_plan: Delete shadow plan with no runtime migration
decision_reason: Architecture value is real but no executed defect exists and the file is protected operational WIP

title: Stabilize dashboard root and exit contracts
reproduction: Public main returns a path while CLI alone propagates computed failure; helper temporarily changes cwd
root_cause: Large module hides process-global root and success-contract seams
test_plan: Typed build-result parity and root restoration tests
rollback_plan: Retain existing API and chdir seam
decision_reason: No current caller failure reproduced and the source is protected

title: Introduce narrow immutable config views
reproduction: 81 modules import a 913-line cross-domain config hub
root_cause: Unrelated policy domains share one broad mutable import surface
rollback_plan: Keep compatibility exports and remove new view
decision_reason: No defect and broad migration would cost more than demonstrated incremental value

title: Read each underlying close frame once per dashboard assembly
reproduction: Static trace shows three reads per regular symbol per assembly
root_cause: Raw adjusted and freshness consumers independently reopen the same parquet
test_plan: Payload parity malformed-store and OOS tests
hard_gate: protected WIP plus no measured bottleneck
decision_reason: Mechanics are verified but performance value is unmeasured and the implementation file is protected

title: Extract policy-neutral H6/H8 helper copies
reproduction: AST comparison found five identical helpers and near-identical contract selection
root_cause: Parallel lane modules copied normalization utilities
decision_reason: Duplication has no demonstrated divergence and extraction risks registered behavior

title: Refresh derived wiki current-status claims
reproduction: Wiki says H7 live H5 trigger active H10a continuing and ThetaData live contrary to current authority
root_cause: Derived notes lack an as-of reconciliation cadence
test_plan: Obsidian link lint and claim-to-canonical-source table
rollback_plan: Revert derived-note-only commit and log entry
hard_gate: current operational claims require separate vault-update authority
decision_reason: High documentation value but this audit was authorized to review the vault not rewrite current operational claims

title: Calibrate execution haircut to realized fills
reproduction: Canonical report states no realized execution records exist
root_cause: Frozen 1 percent haircut has no realized-fill calibration sample
test_plan: Preregistered realized-fill capture calibration and adverse sensitivity
rollback_plan: Keep current frozen haircut and descriptive report
hard_gate: strategy/data-authority change plus no feasible data
decision_reason: No permissible realized-fill evidence exists and config is protected

title: Model capacity impact and assignment mechanics
reproduction: Reviewed engines use OI and spread gates but no volume participation queue impact or full assignment accounting
root_cause: Quote liquidity and option PnL stand in for execution capacity and broker lifecycle
test_plan: Synthetic early-assignment exercise margin and size-consumption scenarios
benchmark_plan: representative historical volume and broker-rule sensitivity
rollback_plan: Retain current C+ realism grade and existing simulator
decision_reason: Requires new model authority provider fields and broker assumptions; no safe default can be invented

title: Implement CSCV or PBO now
reproduction: Current code forces PBO null and ledger trials are heterogeneous
root_cause: No valid comparable parameter grid clears the declared floor
test_plan: Preregistered homogeneous grid with sufficient independent observations
decision_reason: The absence is deliberate and current samples cannot support the statistic
